standard.meaning: Review status records completed source and editorial gates separately from the independent expert-review and production-validation gates, which remain explicitly pending.
standard.accessibilityBaseline: The shared renderer provides keyboard controls, persistent section progress, diagram text alternatives, learner motion controls, and reduced-motion support.
standard.sectionProvenance: A section marked source-reviewed-editorial-pass inherits the containing chapter review and names that parent scope; knowledge-check and diagram reviews remain independent.
standard.diagramCatalog: Shared templates and concrete learner-visible placements are cataloged separately. Inline diagrams exist only as placements; unused templates remain visible in the template registry but are not counted as placements.

findings: Legacy content is preserved but is not automatically approved for native publication.
278 of 278 section records inherit source/editorial review from their explicitly reviewed parent chapters; this does not claim independent section-level expert validation.
Shared renderer accessibility controls are implemented. 58 of 58 learner-visible placements have source-review records; 0 placements still need concept and label review.
58 learner-visible diagram placements are cataloged: 16 use shared templates and 42 are inline chapter diagrams. 10 shared templates are currently unused.
415 of 415 flashcards have source-review records; 0 remain in first-pass review, and independent qualified expert validation is still pending.
80 source-reviewed duplicate flashcards are explicitly retired from future learner release rather than counted as distinct study targets.
255 of 255 memory aids have source-review records and are released; 0 remain in the editorial/source-review queue, and independent qualified expert validation is still pending.
109 of 109 knowledge checks have source-review records and are released to their chapter payloads; 0 remain gated for review.
